$comment: Hand-written per-table notes for things the field list cannot say: how a table is joined, which system reaches it, what silently does nothing. SOURCE FILE, not a generated artifact — scripts/build-index.mjs bakes these into index.json (so the browser needs no extra fetch and the offline Nexus archive stays complete) and scripts/check-index.mjs gates the two against drift. A note naming a table no schema version has is a build error. Every note carries its own provenance; keep them short and put the long version in README.md.

DT_ItemLotteryDataTable.text: Row keys here are counters ("1", "2", "3", …) and carry no meaning. What ties an entry to a drop source is the FieldName column, which names a row in DT_FieldLotteryNameDataTable — so searching this table for a lottery name by row key finds nothing. A new drop is a new row under any key the table does not already have (PalSchema's PalRawTableLoader::Apply sends unknown keys to AddRow). Two traps: SlotNo must be a slot the matching DT_FieldLotteryNameDataTable row actually rolls (ItemSlotN_ProbabilityPercent > 0) or the entry can never come out, and WeightInSlot is relative to the other entries sharing that FieldName + SlotNo, so adding one dilutes the existing pool instead of stacking on top of it.
DT_ItemLotteryDataTable.source: Row keys and the FieldName join: paldex FModel dump of this table. AddRow behaviour: PalSchema src/Loader/PalRawTableLoader.cpp (Apply).

DT_FieldLotteryNameDataTable.text: One row per lottery name, holding nothing but the chance each of the 15 slots rolls at all. The slot contents are in DT_ItemLotteryDataTable, joined by its FieldName column rather than by row key. Field drops and treasure boxes read these rows, and so do lottery buildings: the Ancient Relic Recycler has no DT_ItemRecipeDataTable rows at all, it maps each input relic to a lottery name (AncientRelicRecycler_WorldTreeRelic_01…_05) through UPalMapObjectRecyclerParameterComponent.RelicItemSettings on its blueprint. That map is blueprint data, so which relic feeds which lottery, and how long it takes, is out of PalSchema's reach — the two lottery tables are not.
DT_FieldLotteryNameDataTable.source: SDK headers localcc/PalworldModdingKit@62fad41: PalMapObjectRecyclerParameterComponent.h, PalRecyclerRelicItemSetting.h, PalFieldLotteryName.h.
